As cloning technology had obviously existed, advanced, and perfected by the 22nd century so many animals can grow up healthy. Was there any incidents that celebrities/famous people (such as George Washington, Napoleon,  Adolf Hitler, or even Lionel Halvidar) was cloned at some point?

I understand that they would probably raised and turned out differently, (or perhaps even someone had the idea to combine the DNA of several famous people to create one person )  but I was just wondering if there are any laws or there are none (or little) for people to clone famous dead ones? Or if any cloned famous people had existed?<ac_metadata title="Whats the status of cloning celebrities/famous people?"> </ac_metadata>
